text: The desktop browser pane opens file:// pages outside the project folder as static snapshots that page tools refuse; to measure layout in such a file, run node with the repo's own playwright chromium.

In this Mac's Bash tool (zsh) an unquoted $VAR isn't word-split (use ${=VAR} or an array), '$VAR:refs/...' reads as a ':r' modifier and mangles a git refspec even in double quotes (write ${VAR}:refs/...), and there is no GNU timeout (use the tool's timeout parameter or run_in_background).

A desktop session running in an isolated worktree refuses Write/Edit into any other worktree's files (reads and Bash still work), so a lead launches parallel implementers with Agent isolation 'worktree', or enters the target worktree, and merges their branches back.

jobsnearme: a push of main once failed with 'pack has bad object' while re-sending the 58 MB investor deck; the fix (10-6) was the ours-merge 8bcd2f6b recording deck carrier b93d0bc as an ancestor, and pack.useSparse=false alone did not cure it.

jobsnearme: the owner ruled (10-6, FS-415) that a sign-in code never creates an account (requestSeekerCode with createAccount:false, shouldCreateUser:false), because GoTrue v2.197.0 is read as finding OTP users only by the confirmed users.email column, a reading the live probe has not confirmed.

jobsnearme: the review packet marks the e2e gate SKIPPED whenever any spec prints a GATE-SKIPPED: line (for example a test missing E2E_EMPLOYER_* credentials), even though the full matrix ran, so read the row's reason before assuming the matrix didn't run.

Don't ask Alex to approve small scope overruns (a LOC bump, +1 file, a named test re-aim); record them as build amendments and disclose them, and bring him only egregious overruns, since asking causes churn.
